verdicts.reason: A: the orange divider runs straight through the body copy ('gone'); the body copy is squeezed into a narrow right column that wraps into a tall, ragged stack of 9 lines; the dark header band stops short of the right edge and leaves a cream strip above it; the CTA and legal text are tiny. B: there are no collisions, but the layout is scattered. The 'LIMITED SUMMER RELEASE' eyebrow sits at the bottom-left below the headline, the divider floats loose under the logo block, 'Ships late June' is cut off from its CTA and parked above the legal text, the CTA is undersized and the logo is very small. B is the less broken of the two.
